payload.focus: Tanya's Sprint Retro (2026-09-06): async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This September 2026 sprint retro echoes the March 2026 Sprint 4 retro almost verbatim — same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr-as-key-unlock attribution. I expanded the prior retro document (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322) and every position, observation, and style note sourced from it so the passes can bind this new retro to the existing witness set or flag it as a later recurrence. I also expanded the two core narratives (DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, DecisionsEvaporate) and the AntiSlack positioning thesis with its evidence children (AntiPatternRealtimeChat, CoreFeatureDecisionCapture, ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, TargetMarketRemoteTeams) because the widget shipment is a proof-point for those narratives. Pricing positions (TwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus) and the WebhookArchitecture decision are included because the Sprint 4 retro introduced them and this retro may update or restate them. ContextPreservationNextSprint is included as the stated next-sprint focus that this later retro may address. I did not expand the People or Dimensions doors — the graph has no people axis content and no separate dimensions beyond what the thematic map already surfaced.
